title: Flight Controls — Outboard Flap Carriage Roller Change (Cancelled)
abstract: Cancelled bulletin for the outboard flap carriage roller change, withdrawn after the rigging values published at initial issue were found to be incorrect during the first embodiments.

sections.planning_reason: Wear measurements at the outboard carriage on high-cycle aircraft showed the track reaching its published limit at about nineteen thousand flight cycles rather than the thirty-two thousand assumed in the maintenance programme, and fourteen tracks were replaced early across the fleet in two years. This bulletin was issued to fit the softer-surface roller so that wear is taken by the replaceable item rather than by the track.
sections.description: The bulletin fitted the revised roller set to the outboard carriage and re-rigged the flap. It is cancelled and must not be accomplished.
sections.accomplishment_summary: This Service Bulletin is cancelled and must not be accomplished. The rigging values published at initial issue were taken from the inboard carriage and are incorrect for the outboard position; four aircraft embodied against them were found with a flap asymmetry outside the acceptance band on the post-installation test and had to be re-rigged. Operators who have already accomplished this bulletin must do the re-rigging check in Service Bulletin CRN-27-2012 before further flight. Operators who have not accomplished it should order the kit for CRN-27-2012, which supersedes this bulletin and carries the corrected values, the revised acceptance band and an additional carriage clamp.
sections.effectivity_note: The effectivity is retained for record purposes only. Aircraft embodied against this bulletin between January and June 2025 are identified in the service information letter that accompanied the cancellation and must be re-rigged under the superseding bulletin.
sections.material_note: Kit K2750-2003-01 is withdrawn. Kits already delivered may be used for Service Bulletin CRN-27-2012 with the addition of the carriage clamp supplied separately.

type_data.compliance_time: Cancelled. This Service Bulletin must not be accomplished.
